bug_semantics: The unauthenticated REST /user/login endpoint used HTTP GET and bound the login and password from the user and pass query parameters before passing them to userDao.login. Credentials therefore entered the request URL, where ordinary URL logging, browser history, caches, and referrer handling could disclose them; the endpoint then created and returned a session for valid credentials.
flaw_origin: Apache Subversion revision r1689219 (2015-07-05, author solomax, message '[OPENMEETINGS-1118] SOAP/REST services are reorganized and simplified') first changed UserWebService.login to the vulnerable two-argument form with explicit @QueryParam("user") and @QueryParam("pass") while retaining @GET. Direct predecessor r1689218 has a different GET login signature with unannotated SID, username, and userpass arguments and contains neither vulnerable QueryParam binding. The later Git repository begins at SVN restructuring revision r1719765, so this verified non-Git SVN BIC has no Git SHA or Git parent object.
ai_marker: absent: SVN r1689219 records author solomax and the exact log message '[OPENMEETINGS-1118] SOAP/REST services are reorganized and simplified'; that message has no AI, Co-Authored-By, or Generated-with marker, and Subversion exposes no separate Git-style committer or trailer fields
evidence: CVE.org record CVE-2026-34020 is PUBLISHED and the Apache CNA states that Apache OpenMeetings 3.1.3 through versions before 9.0.0 sent REST login username and password as GET query parameters; it names OPENMEETINGS-2816 and recommends 9.0.0.

Apache's 2026-04-09 oss-security notice says the REST login endpoint used GET with username and password in query parameters, identifies affected versions 3.1.3 before 9.0.0, and credits 4ra2n only as the finder; it does not attribute implementation authorship to that agent.

Apache SVN r1689219, openmeetings/trunk/singlewebapp/openmeetings-webservice/src/main/java/org/apache/openmeetings/webservice/UserWebService.java:93-95, retains @GET and adds login(@WebParam @QueryParam("user") String login, @WebParam @QueryParam("pass") String pass); the method passes those values to userDao.login at line 98 and creates a session on success.

Direct SVN predecessor r1689218 at the same path has @GET login(@WebParam String SID, @WebParam String username, @WebParam String userpass) and contains neither @QueryParam("user") nor @QueryParam("pass"); the r1689218..r1689219 diff directly proves parent absence of the advisory's two-query-parameter mechanism.

The Apache SVN log identifies r1689219 as authored by solomax on 2015-07-05 with message '[OPENMEETINGS-1118] SOAP/REST services are reorganized and simplified'; no AI/co-author/generated-with marker appears in the revision metadata.

SVN r1719765 later added /openmeetings/application/trunk by copying /openmeetings/trunk/singlewebapp@r1719125. Corresponding Git roots 7afb6b9ce7ca4d576fb29bd70868ad1ffff4af07 (3.x) and be2c8e450b634992366abab4d82145d8c9d745e1 (master) are parentless restructuring snapshots, so neither is the first-writing BIC and no Git SHA exists for r1689219.

Git commit e758715c801d9ffa1f40c05d6567f7b8799d6fc9 ([OPENMEETINGS-2816] WS login method now uses POST) directly changes UserWebService.login from @GET to @POST and both parameters from @QueryParam to @FormParam; its direct parent 270ed504fe2962fd6710d9e0fcaff2f43befbfcc still has the vulnerable GET/query form.

Tag topology check: e758715c801d9ffa1f40c05d6567f7b8799d6fc9 is not an ancestor of 8.1.0 (6e39df0c66374341163889006d38d11cd89b5071) but is an ancestor of release 9.0.0 (bff7dfecd5044418471ffc3733f235226585ea06), matching the advisory's patched boundary.
reasoning: The advisory describes a real credential-exposure path, not a withdrawn or rejected report: an unauthenticated caller supplied credentials to /user/login, GET serialized the explicitly bound user/pass values in the URL, userDao.login consumed them, and valid credentials produced a session. History must be followed across the later SVN directory copy rather than treating the parentless Git import as an introducer. Comparing the exact SVN revisions shows that r1689219 first wrote the explicit GET query-credential mechanism and that r1689218 lacks it. The campaign gate explicitly permits a closed NOT_AI result at a verified non-Git SVN/CVS BIC boundary when introducer_sha and introducer_parent are null and parent absence is proven. SVN metadata attributes r1689219 to solomax and contains no AI marker. Finder credit in the 2026 advisory and any later repository AI activity are not BIC authorship evidence. The direct Git fix e758715c801d9ffa1f40c05d6567f7b8799d6fc9 removes the mechanism by using POST form parameters and is included in 9.0.0, so the complete lifecycle supports NOT_AI.
